fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Net Sales, due weekly. Brand Fund Contribution is 2% of weekly Net Sales, with franchisor reserving the right to increase to up to 4.20% upon written notice. Local Advertising Payment equals the difference between actual local ad spend and 1% of Net Sales (on a rolling six-month basis), payable to Brand Fund if shortfall exists. Local/Regional Advertising Cooperatives (not yet established as of issuance date) would range from 0.5% to 2% of Gross Sales. Default Fee is $100 per occurrence per week. Unauthorized Advertising Fee is $500 per occurrence. Unauthorized Merchandise Resale Fee is $500 per occurrence. Tech fee referenced in Item 7 pre-opening ($900–$2,400 single unit) is a pre-opening fee, not a disclosed ongoing monthly tech fee.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty(2) 5% of Net Sales Due on Wednesday of each week The "Royalty" is based on "Net Sales" during the previous week.
Brand Fund Contribution 2% of your weekly Net Sales Same as Royalty We reserve the right to increase the Brand Fund Contribution to up to 4.20% upon written notice to you.
Local Advertising Payment The difference between the amount you spent on local advertising each month and your required local advertising expenditure (1% of your Net Sales) Payable after receipt of invoice
Local and Regional Advertising Cooperatives Established by cooperative members, between 0.5% and 2% of Gross Sales Established by cooperative members
Default Fee $100 per occurrence per week On demand
Unauthorized Advertising Fee $500 per occurrence On demand
Unauthorized Merchandise Resale $500 per occurrence On demand
